primarySources.supports: Reveal first, then optional normal-draw replacement; all-high reveal example draws two subsequent cards. Random acquisition includes hand and equipment. Pure discard and recast are not used-card claims.

rules.mingcha: Mandatory native public reveal of up to three top entities precedes the owner's optional replacement. The chosen replacement obtains the original <=8 entities, disposes all original remaining Processing entities through native movement, and cancels only the original actual normal-draw parent. Declining settles the revealed entities to discard and leaves native subsequent normal draw and order intact. The original reveal receipt freezes all physical entities and movement ranges across children and replay.

zeroMatch.explanation: The current text says if choosing this replacement, and does not require gaining at least one card. A zero-match replacement therefore gains zero reveal cards but retains the optional random HE acquisition. This does not import an older mobile requirement to have gained a card.

rules.randomHE: Choose another living role, then use the native seeded random source over its actual current Hand and Equipment entities. Judgment is excluded. The target menu carries no hidden card IDs and does not bias toward Hand. Native Silver Lion, Wooden Ox and GeneralWeapon destination normalization apply; actual paid movement is never rerolled after a child.
rules.jingzhong: Freeze actual own Discard-phase token and genuine black discard movements. The chosen other role receives a lease for its first subsequently entered actual Play phase; a skipped phase is not an entered Play and an extra Play is eligible. The owner/skill-instance has a shared three-Use acquisition limit in that phase even if multiple leases apply. One actual Use action is one opportunity and may contain multiple physical entities. True used Slash-defense Dodge and Nullification responses count; played-out Slash/AOE Dodge, recast and an unlinked discard do not.

residency.status: Implementation inference from current OL text, which does not restrict acquisition to immediate use completion
residency.explanation: Each physical invoice starts at the exact native accepted Use/payment. Actual native Processing cleanup is eligible. Equipment or delayed cards genuinely placed on the board retain that invoice while they remain in that same board residency, and may be obtained if they enter discard later within the leased Play. Transfer, acquisition into Hand, leaving and reentering the board, a different native Use, phase expiry or a stale discard sequence terminates the old invoice. An orphaned Processing discard is rejected. Native abolished-slot equipment cleanup additionally requires the exact still-live Equipment Use frame, action and physical material.

rules.actorOwnership: Declared physical-use facts follow the exact native same-Use actor replacement chain. Response facts retain the actual responder and are never reassigned with their parent attack actor. The original physical provider does not become the final actual user.
rules.sourceLifetime: A granted lease is event-derived and remains effective after issuer skill loss while that issuer is alive. Issuer death does not fabricate a recipient; already-paid movements drain their real child windows. Pending reveal, choice, random selection and claims live only on their owning nullable ProgramSkillFrame receipt. Collections defensively copy both construction and init values.
